13:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Football
The Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets (3-7, 2-5 ACC) host the No. 11 Wake Forest Demon Deacons (9-1, 6-1) in Atlanta. With only one loss this season, Wake Forest enters after beating SMU 49-7, while Georgia Tech beat Clemson 20-6 behind Alberto Mendoza.
